name: Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B
context_scaling: Inherited from Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (native 262,144). The card ships quant tiers sized for context headroom rather than extending context.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B: 10 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 256) alternating with 30 gated linear-attention layers, multi-token-prediction head kept (MTP) for the speculative-decoding sweep the card publishes.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-21. A coding post-train of Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, distributed only as GGUF. Why it is worth a record: it is the most-downloaded coding fine-tune in the corpus (1.91M on this repo alone) and its card reports SWE-bench-Live 12/25 against 8/25 for stock, while running 8.6 minutes per attempt against 50.2 for Qwen3.8-27B (which solves 16). That combination — a bit worse than the 27B but 6x cheaper per attempt — is the actual finding, not the headline "level with Opus 4.6". Two caveats are load-bearing: n=25 single run (one solve = 4 points, so 12 vs 8 is four solves and the gap to 16 is a solve count, not a percentage), and the trade is explicit on the card — answer quality +3.8 against the base but 5.1 points WORSE at asking clarifying questions, which is the behaviour that matters for agentic work. MMLU-Pro 73.7 at 4-bit is below Nail at 84.0 in the same card, so this is a coding specialist that gives up general knowledge.
